title: Teaching algorithm parameters
header: Teaching algorithm parameters. Delete this file to return to defaults.
Every value below is also editable from Teach > Teaching Config.

fields.description: M-point match score at or above which a hit counts

Safety ceiling on returned matches. Must sit FAR above the real board count: reaching it silently truncates to the strongest N, and which ones survive is then arbitrary. The PCB Map log warns if it is hit.
Report positions that SHOULD hold a board but do not. Only meaningful once the matcher returns about one hit per board - check the match count against the board count in the PCB Map log line first.
How far two board origins may sit apart and still be one column/row, as a fraction of the taught PCB size
Share of the typical column/row population a cluster must reach to be believed, which is what rejects one-off matches
Check each located board for its configured Chip/Cavity ROIs
Correlation at or above which a component counts as present

Folder of panel images to run this model against when there is no camera. Absolute path - it describes this application's disk, not the model, so a model folder copied to another machine is expected to need it re-pointed.

File name (not a path) of the image last opened from that folder. Blank starts at the first image there. This is NOT the panel the ROIs were taught on - that stays in PanelRgninfo.txt, and the two may legitimately differ.
